QuestInfo.name: Beginner Thief's Second Training Session
QuestInfo.0: You feel stronger, but you still have a long way to go. Talk to #b#p1052001##k again for training.
QuestInfo.1: #p1052001# says the best way to learn is to keep hunting monsters. He says to hunt #r20 #o1120100#es#k. \n\n#o1120100# #r#a21411##k
QuestInfo.2: You hunted 20 #o1120100#es and reported in to #p1052001#. In spite of your hard work, #p1052001# told you it was an easy job...

0.0: 흠. 애송이 도적의 기량이 전보다는 나아진 것 같군. 그래봤자오십보 백보지만 말이야. 아직 한참 멀었어. 아무래도 이 다크로드의 수련을 계속 받지 않으면 안 되겠는걸? 어때? 수련을 해보겠는가?

yes.0: 그렇다면 스텀프 50마리를 사냥해 보라고. 한 번 사냥해 본 몬스터이니 별로 어렵지는 않겠지. 스텀프를 계속 사냥해서 기초수련을 보다 확실히 한 후 다시 이곳으로 와서 보고하라고.

no.0: 스스로의 힘으로도 수련할 자신이 있다면, 그렇게 해보라고. 얼마나 할 수 있을지는 모르겠지만 말이야.

0.0: Hmm. You seem to be improved. That doesn't make a big difference though. You have a long way to go. You should be trained by #p1052001#. What do you think? Would you like to go for training?

yes.0: Then, try hunting #r20 #o1120100#es#k. It shouldn't be too difficult, since you've already fought this monster before. Continue to train by hunting the #o1120100#, then come back and report to me.

no.0: If you train by yourself, do it. I wonder how long you can do that.

1.0: You've eliminated 20 #o1120100#es. Not bad... Not bad for a rookie Thief. Huh? What's with the confident face? You don't think you've accomplished something amazing, do you? Believe me, you still have much to learn.

yes.0: I'll call you when you need another training session. Until we meet again...keep training hard!

mob.0: You still haven't eliminated #r20 #o1120100#es#k. You are more than capable of handling them. Do not be scared, fight with confidence.
